      LEARN THE ROPES

      CONTROLS

      ACTIONPLAYER 1PLAYER 2Move / jump← → / ↑A D / WStrike / heavyZ / XF / GGrapple / pinCHSubmission↓ + CS + HBlock↓SFinisherVRChange weaponQTTauntEYRunHold direction / ShiftHold direction / ShiftPauseEsc / PEsc / P

      Online: both players use the Player 1 keys on their own device; the joining player controls P2. Online matches keep running while menus are open. Player 1 can also use J / K / L / U for actions. WASD also moves Player 1 in solo modes. Player 2 can use 1 / 2 / 3 / 0 for actions.

      Phone: slide your left thumb across the D-pad. Up jumps; down blocks. Use the right buttons to attack. GRAB changes to PIN beside a downed opponent and BREAK when you are grabbed. Tap KICK OUT repeatedly when pinned. Both orientations keep the controls outside the ring. Turning your phone pauses an offline match so you can reset your grip. Choose SAVE BATTERY below if your phone gets warm.

      Land HIT, then tap HIT again during the impact to link a second strike. Tap HEAVY after either hit for a follow-up. Chains stop at three hits and follow-ups deal reduced damage. A missed or blocked attack keeps its recovery; slow weapons leave more room to counter.

      Run into a rope to rebound toward center, then tap HEAVY for a running attack. Down cancels the rebound into a guard. CPU fighting styles and finisher reach vary with each fighter’s approved ratings. Technique also improves guard recovery.

      Hold a direction to smoothly build into a run. Tap HEAVY while running toward your opponent for a short lunging attack. It deals normal damage and leaves you open if blocked or missed. For every fighter, WEAPON cycles bare hands, chair, bat, guitar and trash can. Tony also has a bottle. Hold Down + HEAVY for a guard counter; tap HEAVY in the air for an air strike. A landed HIT → HIT → HEAVY chain knocks your opponent down. HEAVY uses your equipped gear; weapons have limited landed hits: chair 4, bat 6, guitar 2, trash can 3, bottle 1. Switching keeps their wear; a fresh round restores them. Whiffs and blocks do not spend durability. TAUNT earns 12 meter if you finish it safely.

      At either corner with space from your opponent, GRAB becomes CLIMB. At the top, tap Jump or an attack to dive; use FINISH with full meter for a stronger dive. TAUNT on the top rope earns 20 meter, but leaves you open. GRAB near a perched opponent performs a SUPERPLEX for extra damage; a perched attacker can also grab an opponent below. The defender can tap GRAB during the first 0.38 seconds to escape. Down climbs off. A missed or blocked dive leaves you down and open to a pin.

      Time your block just before a normal strike lands to REVERSE it: press Down on keyboard or phone, or LB on a controller. Keep guarding through impact, then release and counterattack. A reversal briefly staggers the attacker and earns 12 Lunacy. Holding block defends normally; reversal attempts have a short cooldown and need guard remaining. Finishers, grabs and dives keep their usual counters.

      SECOND WIND activates once per round when an opponent drops you to 30 health or less without knocking you out. It adds 25 Lunacy and restores some guard, giving you a chance to build a comeback finisher. It does not heal you or interrupt a knockdown.

      Grapple close to throw. Tap GRAB as an opponent catches you to break the throw. Simultaneous grabs break apart fairly. Hold Down + GRAB beside a downed opponent for a submission hold. Pins and submissions near either rope are broken by the referee. Tap GRAB again to release your own hold. Alternate strike and heavy to escape pins or submissions on keyboard or gamepad; on phone, tap the large ESCAPE button. Fill the LUNACY meter, then use your finisher close to your opponent. PRACTICE gives you a passive opponent and full meter.

      WEAPON ON A POLE: choose CPU or local two-player. Both begin bare-handed. Climb the marked corner, then hold GRAB/CLAIM for just over one second to retrieve the chair. A knockdown, grapple or climbing again drops it; either wrestler can approach and press WEAPON to pick it up. The chair breaks after four landed hits. Retrieval does not win the match: win two falls by KO, pin or submission. A new chair hangs on the opposite corner each round.

      ARCADE: clear the full roster on Easy, Normal or Hard to earn a bronze, silver or gold medal and a matching portrait frame. Complete all three difficulties with a fighter for their Triple Crown frame. Medals save on this browser; each fighter has their own collection. Arcade runs must be completed in one session.

      CHAMPIONSHIP: win five matches to claim the belt, then defend it against fresh challengers. A loss on the road lets you retry that match. Losing a title defense sends you on a new title chase; title wins and your best defense streak remain. Progress saves between matches on this browser, separately for each fighter and difficulty. Leaving during a match restarts that match when you return. Winning the belt once unlocks the secret fighters on this browser.

      Gamepad: stick / D-pad to move, A jump, X strike, Y heavy, B grapple, LB block, RB finisher, LT weapon, RT taunt, Start pause.
